title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a form that could be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category is converted into a new binary column.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding more features to a model can increase its complexity. This can lead to overfitting, where the model fits the training data too closely and may not generalize well to new data.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Adding more features can increase the variance of the model, potentially increasing the model's bias squared. However, it can also decrease bias if the features are relevant.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Consider whether adding one-hot encoded weather features would increase or decrease the model's bias squared.
